data.description: An ochre jelly secretes a digestive acid that dissolves only flesh (not bone) when it strikes a foe; creatures not made of flesh (including most constructs and oozes, skeletal undead, plants, and incorporeal creatures) are immune to the ochre jelly's acid damage.
